title: SCHWAB CHARLES CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Charles Schwab Corporation issued 1,500,000 depositary shares representing Series L Preferred Stock (6.100% fixed-rate reset non-cumulative perpetual preferred) with net proceeds of approximately $1,480 million after deducting underwriting discounts, commissions, and estimated offering expenses. The Series L Preferred Stock has a liquidation preference of $100,000 per share (equivalent to $1,000 per Depositary Share).

Liquidation preference: $100,000 per share ($1,000 per Depositary Share)
